## Temperature

Steam milk to about 55 to 65 degrees Celsius. Past roughly 70 degrees the milk scalds and loses its natural sweetness.

## Microfoam

Keep the steam wand tip just below the surface at first to stretch the milk, then lower it to spin the milk into a smooth, glossy microfoam with no visible bubbles.
